title: QA Pilot Seal Authority Gate
description: Governed regression gate preventing unauthorized seal transitions. Every sprint must have explicit Owner seal evidence before the ledger status may be set to 'sealed'. Agent-authored seal assertions, epic-implied seal, validator-implied seal, and session handoff 'sealed' entries without Owner evidence are all rejected.

current_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the sprint.

has_owner_seal_evidence.description: Whether explicit Owner seal evidence exists for this sprint.

seal_evidence_type.description: Type of seal evidence: explicit 'seal sprint N' command, Owner decision receipt, or none.

seal_evidence_ref.description: Reference to the seal evidence (e.g. 'Owner command at YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM', OD receipt ID).

seal_eligible.description: Whether the sprint is implementation-complete and eligibile for Owner seal review.

proposed_correction.description: Recommended action if seal authority is violated.

audit_finding.description: Classification of the seal authority audit finding.

advisory_only.description: Must always be true. Gate entries are advisory-only.

created_at.description: When this gate entry was created.
